projectSummary: A single case establishes that the injury occurs during the index exercise. It establishes nothing about how often.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: n = 1. A case report cannot support an incidence, a rate, or a comparison between exercises.

study.population: A complex intratendinous rupture of the pectoralis major occurred during heavy bench pressing, and is reported with imaging and operative findings.

title: Complex Intratendinous Pectoralis Major Rupture After Heavy Bench Press.
